purpose: Exploratory UI concepts; proposed workflow and sample data, not implemented functionality or an actual participant capture.

variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity landscape iPad application screen concept for MANTA, a scientific head-scanning acquisition app. A single large flat UI screenshot, 4:3 landscape, no physical device frame, no external captions or presentation background. Crisp readable native iPad typography, light white/off-white chrome, dark live viewports, restrained blue/teal accents and amber warnings, generous 44pt touch targets. Top toolbar always has "Subject" and "Experiment" pills at upper left, "MANTA" center, "Head-only • Pass 1" at right. This is a proposed UI, not a claim that these features exist. The view is permanently split: live camera on the left showing a fictional adult seated against an ordinary lab wall, grayscale incomplete LiDAR head surface on the right. Do not use a real person's likeness or any prior attached image. Camera and mesh show the same pose and scale. Mesh must be coarse, incomplete measured geometry, not a polished face. No Camera / Interactive / Split selector. Small expand icons on each viewport. Reduce visual workspace height by approximately 15% to free room for persistent guidance. Keep a right-side narrow action column with "Pause", "Sample Frame", "Hi-Res Photo" directly below Sample Frame, and amber "Subject moved". A persistent single continuous subway-line route with six clickable stations in this exact order: "Setup", "Reference", "Orbit", "Photos", "Review", "Finish". Setup and Reference completed with checkmarks, Orbit active in blue, Photos/Review/Finish outlined future stops. Only one route line. Use state labels or shapes in addition to color. Do not invent a percent-complete or imply clinical accuracy. Sensor status short text: "Tracking normal", "Depth saving", "Motion check armed". Overall calm, practical, readable control-room software, not a marketing dashboard. Layout A — TOP ROUTE. Place the horizontal subway route directly beneath the top toolbar spanning the entire width. Under it, the two large equal viewports fill the middle-left 83% width, action column at right. A bottom guidance band about 15% of height contains left-aligned title "Orbit • left side", instruction "Keep the head still. Move the iPad slowly toward the back.", evidence chips "4 of 5 directions seen" and amber "Crown still needed". Right side of guidance band has prominent "Continue to Photos" and secondary "Stay on Orbit". A small footnote "View coverage is guidance, not surface completeness." Readable concise typography. All guidance remains outside camera images. This is the cleanest least disruptive proposal.
